messages:
maria: quick heads-up — PR #5423 (api/generate examples) is blocked on a small but blocking tech clarification. the SDK snippet shows streaming but the HTTP example is non-streaming, and we don't state the config default for stream behavior. can someone from runtime confirm before i merge?

sanjay: which part of the SDK example? link?

maria: in the PR diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5423/files — see the python snippet under "server-side usage". it uses `for chunk in client.generate(..., stream=True):` but the curl example is just a single response. also the config reference page says `streaming` but doesn't state default (empty).

alex: also FYI the docs preview failed on my re-run earlier, looks like mkdocs choking on that new cross-link to /models/catalog.html — build log:```ERROR - 2:35:12 PM - mkdocs.exceptions.NavigationError: The 'models/catalog.html' page is not found in the theme pages.``` ci-bot posted the preview: https://ci.redwood-inference.dev/preview/5423

ci-bot: preview status: failed — https://ci.redwood-inference.dev/preview/5423 (logs attached)

kevin: @sanjay can you confirm runtime defaults? if default is non-streaming we should update the SDK snippet to show both modes and mark streaming as opt-in.

sanjay: confirmed — server default is non-streaming. streaming is opt-in and enabled via `stream=true` query param or passing `Accept: text/event-stream` header; SDKs wrap that with `stream=True`/`stream=False` flags. additionally note: max_tokens default is 512 unless overridden by the model config, so examples that omit it can diverge in output length.

maria: perfect, thanks. i'll: 1) update the python SDK snippet to show both sync and streaming examples, 2) add a short sentence on default being non-streaming and how to opt in, and 3) call out the max_tokens default.

alex: once you push those edits i'll re-run the preview. the cross-link error looks like a broken relative path when the new catalog anchor isn't in the nav yet — i'll fix nav if you want, but i can also patch the link to the absolute /models/catalog/ page.

maria: i'll update snippets and add an absolute link to avoid preview break. planning to push in ~30m. who can review the final PR for approval? need one docs + one runtime sign-off.

sanjay: i can sign off on the runtime bits after you push.

kevin: i'll do the docs review after alex sanity-checks the preview. merge timing? maria: aiming EOD today if no surprises. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: reminder — please add `CHANGELOG.md` entry and tag the PR with `docs-next`.

maria: added changelog entry and tag. pushing now.

alex: re-run preview started. (will post result)

ci-bot: preview status: success — https://ci.redwood-inference.dev/preview/5423 if all green pls request review.

alex: looks good, cross-link fixed and examples render. one minor nit: code fence language in the sync example was `python3` — changed to `python` for consistency.

sanjay: LGTM on the runtime clarifications.

kevin: reviewed final wording, small grammar tweak, approved. :shipit:

maria: thanks everyone — merging now. will monitor prod docs build for the next hour and revert if anything odd shows up.
